fcd_lane_observations.classification: exploratory FCD observation accounting; not a queue-storage, delay, or causal metric

definitions.sample: one vehicle record in one FCD timestep
definitions.vehicle_seconds: stopped samples × validated uniform FCD timestep

limitations: FCD-only: no tripinfo completeness or arrival requirement.
A stopped sample is not a unique vehicle, queue length, effective storage, delay, or causal effect.
Composite ramp-path totals overlap their atomic component rows by design; do not sum both.
